Definition of done:
- `GET /v1/invoices` and `GET /v1/invoices/{id}` (and create, pay, void) return 200 for invoices with no lines, with `description` set to `""`. A regression test reproduces the panic and passes.
- Free-plan (price 0) renewals and first invoices get one plan line with the existing description format, the subscription quantity, and unit_amount 0. They are marked paid immediately.
- A metered renewal with no usage creates no invoice. `go build`, `go test` and `go vet` pass.

## Cause

`describe()` in `internal/api/invoices.go` read `lines[0]` without checking the length. Any invoice with no lines made the list and get handlers panic, and the server answered 500. Two things produced such invoices:
- A licensed plan with price 0 got no line, because `invoicePeriod` only added the line when `UnitAmount > 0`.
- A metered renewal with no usage still created an empty invoice.

## Changes

- `internal/api/invoices.go`: `describe` returns `""` when there are no lines. This is the fix for the panic.
- `internal/subscriptions/subscriptions.go`, `invoicePeriod`:
  - A licensed plan always gets its line, including at price 0.
  - A metered period with no usage returns early, so no invoice is created. The subscription still advances.
- Tests:
  - `internal/api/api_test.go`: `TestInvoiceWithoutLinesIsAnswered` stores an invoice with no lines and checks that list and get answer 200 with an empty description. It failed with 500 before the fix.
  - `internal/subscriptions/subscriptions_test.go`: `TestFreePlanIsInvoicedWithALine` checks the first and renewal invoices for a free plan. `TestMeteredRenewalWithoutUsageCreatesNoInvoice` checks that no invoice is created. Both failed before the fix.

## Verification

`go test ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go build ./...` all pass after the change. I did not run `gofmt`, which is not in the allowed command list.

## Choices and gaps

- The `describe` fix covers all reads of the description. I did not add other guards, because no other code indexes an invoice's lines.
- Nothing was committed.
